description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single hybrid ranged attacks (0.60 or 1.50 each), grants [Attach Lightning], [Overflow Lightning Radiant Shield: 75%], [Awoken Lightning], [Damage Cap +10000], [Quick Cast] and [Electrostatic Mode] to the user

description.name: Awoken Lightning
description.text: Lightning abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Lightning abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Attach Lightning
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Lightning damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Lightning resistance +20%

description.name: Overflow Lightning Radiant Shield: 75%
description.text: Returns 75% of the damage taken to the attacker as Lightning damage capped at 99999

description.name: Electrostatic Mode
description.text: Grants [Overflow Lightning Radiant Shield: 125%]/[Overflow Lightning Radiant Shield: 200%]/[Overflow Lightning Radiant Shield: 300%] after using 1/2/3+ Lightning attacks

description.name: Overflow Lightning Radiant Shield: 125%
description.text: Returns 125% of the damage taken to the attacker as Lightning damage capped at 99999

description.name: Overflow Lightning Radiant Shield: 200%
description.text: Returns 200% of the damage taken to the attacker as Lightning damage capped at 99999

description.name: Overflow Lightning Radiant Shield: 300%
description.text: Returns 300% of the damage taken to the attacker as Lightning damage capped at 99999
